producers.process: initial Root scheduler / Receiver / resume scheduler by stage
producers.repeat: Each progress stage at most once under frozen writers/once handoff
producers.variable_fields: Closed native schema: identity, window, timestamps, bounded stage/revision/hash
producers.external_lengths: Trusted kernel/Root values; no raw systemctl/error/traceback field
producers.dedup: single handoff state, stage conditions, classification_count/resume_count
producers.identity_guard: Root-owned state, window/counter/case/receiver binding; no per-record size check

producers.trigger: Authenticated durable PREPARE reply and fresh commit
producers.repeat: One frozen sender_prepare call; no automatic PREPARE retry
producers.dedup: fresh initial state + single sender call

producers.trigger: Persistent ready pidfd for exited scheduler; no waitpid witness yet yields PENDING
producers.repeat: PENDING self-loop arbitrary finite n in contract scheduling model
producers.variable_fields: Base plus fixed facts map and verdict
producers.external_lengths: witness integer/null; no unbounded error text, task_id or systemd output in native check row
producers.dedup: No PENDING counter/dedup; classification_count constrains successful transition only
producers.recovery: HANDOFF_VERIFIED returns early; no PENDING after verified/resumed path
producers.identity_guard: check_base(...False), live Receiver/coordinator, stable budget/ticket/ready hashes
